title: Indian Railways just moved 135 million tonnes of freight in a single month
sources: Deccan Chronicle - Indian Railways freight loading grows 6.14% in September
PSU Connect - Indian Railways records 6.14% growth in freight loading in September 2026
caption:
Indian Railways just moved 135 million tonnes of freight in a single month. Up more than 6% from the same month last year.

Indian Railways loaded 135.35 million tonnes of freight in September 2026, up 6.14% year-on-year. Foodgrain loading jumped 25%, clinker loading rose 20% and daily coal rake supply to power houses climbed to 443 rakes, an 11.6% increase. Freight revenue rose 9.3% year-on-year - up Rs 1,266 crore - with April-September cumulative loading reaching 833.7 million tonnes, up 4.1%.

A single month's freight numbers can be noise. Six straight months of growth across food, cement and coal is a trend.

Sources: Deccan Chronicle, PSU Connect, citing Ministry of Railways data (2026)
